name: mcp-remote
summary: npx tool that lets an MCP client that only supports local stdio servers connect to a remote MCP server, including OAuth flows.
description: Usage: `npx -y mcp-remote https://example.remote/server` (add `--transport sse-only` for SSE-only servers). npm `mcp-remote` 0.15.2. The repository is now under punkpeye (Glama).
